Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping

Battle of Hat Dich.fact: Between 6–10 December 1 RAR continued to sweep AO Wondai, uncovering a number of ammunition caches and several freshly dug graves, however there was little contact between the Australians and the VC.

Battle of Hat Dich.question: Under the command of _____, 4 RAR/NZ was subsequently committed from Nui Dat to prevent the further northward movement of PAVN/VC forces

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: Patrolling with companies mounted in _____, 4 RAR/NZ operated west of Route 15 and conducted a number of successful ambushes

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: Meanwhile, 1 RAR continued operations in _____, the most active of the TAORs that made up AO Townsville

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: Meanwhile, 1 RAR continued operations in _____ with minor contact
Battle of Hat Dich.fact: Meanwhile, 1 RAR continued operations in AO Wondai, the most active of the TAORs that made up AO Townsville.

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: Meanwhile, just after 12:00 a patrol from B _____ engaged six PAVN after crossing a river
Battle of Hat Dich.fact: On 12 December C Company 1 RAR—under the command of Major Brian Honner—engaged a small VC force in a bunker system in a minor skirmish which saw the Australians capture the position after using M72 rockets. Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: That afternoon B _____ was again in contact after uncovering another bunker system and withdrew to destroy the complex with indirect fire
Battle of Hat Dich.fact: On 12 December C Company 1 RAR—under the command of Major Brian Honner—engaged a small VC force in a bunker system in a minor skirmish which saw the Australians capture the position after using M72 rockets. Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: The next morning B _____ returned to the bunkers and found them deserted

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: Later, on 13 _____, C Company continued its patrol program, when at 10:00 the lead section from 7 Platoon was fired on by VC in another bunker system
Battle of Hat Dich.fact: Later, on 13 December, C Company continued its patrol program, when at 10:00 the lead section from 7 Platoon was fired on by VC in another bunker system.

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: Contacts continued throughout the afternoon with little result, while the _____ continued to uncover numerous prepared positions and bunker systems

Battle of Hat Dich.fact: At 08:40 on the morning of 14 December 9 Platoon C Company 1 RAR engaged two Viet Cong in a bunker system and killed them both.

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: The company continued patrolling, and that afternoon at 16:05 8 _____ contacted two more VC, killing one and uncovering a disused camp
Battle of Hat Dich.fact: At 17:00 7 Platoon contacted 14 VC armed with AK-47 assault rifles on the edge of a clearing, killing one while the others withdrew to a bunker system and engaged the Australians with small arms and 60 mm mortars. Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: Further VC were observed moving west out of the battalion's AO, with elements of the US 3/17th _____ subsequently deployed

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Battle of Hat Dich.question: That afternoon D _____ also uncovered an unoccupied bunker system, while A and B Company each had minor contacts, with 4 Platoon killing one VC around 16:00

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping

Battle of Hat Dich.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
